_note: Adjudicated verdicts (Level 3 files in theorem_comparisons/, Level 2 CSVs for sources without an L3 file) and the paper citation list. Edited by hand; each entry points to its evidence. threat_final follows protocol §2 (conservative upward when reviewers disagree; disagreement recorded).

sources.title: On stability of tensor networks and canonical forms
sources.verdict: First-order (O(eps^2) remainder), network-dependent site-perturbation bounds; no finite-eta bound, no sharp constant, no tree-independence.

sources.title: Numerical stability of tree tensor network operations, and a stable rounding algorithm
sources.authors: Baboulin, M.; Kaya, O.; Mary, T.; Robeyns, M.
sources.verdict: Finite-precision first-order stability bounds for TTN operations; constants possibly pessimistic; not sharp.

sources.title: Hierarchical singular value decomposition of tensors
sources.verdict: Quasi-optimal HSVD truncation with sqrt(2d-3); projections act on one fixed tensor; author notes non-optimality; no extremizers.

sources.title: Rank-adaptive time integration of tree tensor networks
sources.verdict: Thm A.1: telescoping, tree-shape-independent, linear (d-1) bound for rank truncation; not sharp, no eta-dependence. Must be cited and distinguished.

sources.title: The optimal error bound for the method of simultaneous projections
sources.verdict: Exact norm for averaged projections via self-adjointness; different operator family.

sources.title: Error bounds for the method of alternating projections
sources.verdict: Sharp ||(P2P1)^n - P_M|| = c^(2n-1); different quantity (convergence to intersection). Original not read (paywall).

sources.title: The rate of convergence for the method of alternating projections, II
sources.verdict: Angle-only bounds cannot be exact for >=3 subspaces for all configurations; paper must define 'sharp' as worst case over the (k,eta) class. Repo bib had wrong DOI 10.1006/jmaa.1997.5216.

sources.title: Products of orthogonal projections
sources.verdict: Factorization theory; Lemma 2(a) builds the same planar chain of line projections (acting as prod cos theta_j e^{i theta_j}) but proves no extremality.

sources.title: Nearly optimal bounds for cyclic forgetting
sources.verdict: Exact numerical-range spiral for products of projections; reduction to C^2 and equal-factor extremality (Lemma 5); different quantity, no defect constraint. Supplement unread.

sources.title: The numerical range and the spectrum of a product of two orthogonal projections
sources.verdict: Exact numerical range of P2P1; two factors, no |1-prod| objective.

sources.title: On the optimal error bound for the first step in the method of cyclic alternating projections
sources.threat_note: DISPUTED: L3 reader 1 (full text), L2 reader 3; conservative value recorded; author adjudication requested
sources.verdict: Best constants for ||P_n...P_1 - P_0|| under a global Friedrichs-number constraint; exact only n=3; lower bound uses equally spaced planar lines. Global constraint and different error.

sources.title: Duality between smooth min- and max-entropies
sources.verdict: Generalized fidelity / purified distance; lift rho -> rho (+) (1 - tr rho) is our lift; Lemma A known; Lemma C known in absolute-value form.

sources.title: Quantum Information Processing with Finite Resources
sources.verdict: Eq. (3.39) vector generalized fidelity; Prop. 3.16 triangle inequality.

sources.title: Strengths and weaknesses of quantum computing
sources.verdict: Hybrid argument; telescoping scheme of Theorem D.

sources.title: Exact quantum lower bound for Grover's problem
sources.verdict: Lemma 4: angle-version hybrid argument (replace one step, add angles).

sources.title: Scaled relative graphs: nonexpansive operators via 2D Euclidean geometry
sources.verdict: Thm 7 'angles add, lengths multiply'; Facts 16-17 spherical triangle inequality and cardioid envelope for two projection-type factors; no lift, no trees, no eta constraint.

sources.title: The scaled relative graph of a linear operator
sources.verdict: SRG of a single linear operator via numerical range; no composition, no projections chains.

sources.title: A matrix lower bound
sources.verdict: Lemma 6.3 (rank-2 nuclear norm) gives the tensor-angle inequality as an equality for m=2.

sources.title: Tight coefficients of averaged operators via scaled relative graph
sources.verdict: Thm 1 (theta1=theta2=1/2) rigorously gives the two-factor product region = cardioid w(t)^2; Cor. 1 bounds a different quantity. Two factors only.

sources.title: Exact Minkowski products of N complex disks
sources.verdict: Sec. 5: boundary of the N-fold Minkowski power of |z-1/2|<=1/2 lies on t -> w(t)^N (heuristic argument). Covers R7 only for alpha=pi/2 (threat 3 for that sub-case); nothing on |1-z|, arcs, or angle caps. Cite for the geometric picture, not for rigor.

sources.title: Minkowski geometric algebra of complex sets
sources.verdict: Minkowski geometric algebra framework; two-disk Cartesian ovals, cardioid as degenerate case; enclosure claim stated without proof (per HRY). Do not quote specific content until full text read.

sources.title: Error transportation in SVD-based tensor-train approximations
sources.verdict: Truncation error transport through dimension trees with tree/data-dependent constants; exact Pythagorean identity only for chains; opposite of R3. MANUAL: download PDF (HAL bot check). [authors from L2 agent; VERIFY on HAL PDF]

sources.title: Approximation by tree tensor networks in high dimensions: Sobolev and compositional functions
sources.verdict: Lemma 4.9: nodewise accumulation of nested nonexpansive approximations in a tree of compositions (L-infinity, depth-growing non-sharp constants). [title from memory: VERIFY against arXiv:2112.01474]
sources.authors: Bachmayr, M.; Nouy, A.; Schneider, R.

sources.title: The rate of linear convergence of the Douglas-Rachford algorithm for subspaces is the cosine of the Friedrichs angle
sources.verdict: For two lines at angle theta the DR operator is cos(theta) times rotation by theta: same planar factor cos(theta) e^{i theta}; different result.

sources.title: The method of alternating projections and the method of subspace corrections in Hilbert space
sources.verdict: Sharp identity for the norm of a product of projections; different quantity; expected citation.

sources.title: Convergence properties of dynamic string-averaging projection methods in the presence of perturbations
sources.verdict: Thm 11: perturbation errors accumulate at most linearly (crude first-order analogue of R1a).
